title: Buying Out, Paying and Disputing a Deductible on the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
Where a deductible arises on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election, three terms of the level decide how
it may be dealt with: whether the deductible can be bought out for the trip and at what fee, how many
instalments it may be paid over and how many calendar days separate them, and how many calendar days the guest
has, counted from the day the deductible was raised, within which to dispute it.

| Protection level | Deductible may be bought out | Buy-out fee (USD) | Instalments the deductible may be paid over | Calendar days between instalments | Dispute window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | no | 0.00 | 1 | 0 | 14 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | no | 0.00 | 2 | 30 | 14 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | yes | 145.00 | 3 | 30 | 21 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | yes | 95.00 | 3 | 30 | 30 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | no | 0.00 | 1 | 0 | 30 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | no | 0.00 | 1 | 0 | 45 |

## The same terms as conditions

- A buy-out is written into two of the six levels: Keyturn Standard Protection at 145.00 USD and Keyturn
  Advantage Protection at 95.00 USD. The other four record no buy-out and a fee of 0.00 USD.
- Three levels are written for a single payment: Keyturn Declined Protection, Keyturn Premier Protection and
  Keyturn Business Traveler Protection each record 1 instalment and an interval of 0 calendar days. Keyturn
  Minimum Protection records 2 instalments and the three middle levels an interval of 30 calendar days,
  with Keyturn Standard Protection and Keyturn Advantage Protection recording 3 instalments.
- The dispute window widens along the ladder, from 14 calendar days on the two lowest levels to 45 on Keyturn
  Business Traveler Protection.

## Boundary reading of a dispute window

On a hypothetical election covered at a level whose dispute window is 21 calendar days, a deductible raised on
the first day of a month is inside the window on the twenty-first day counted from that day, that day included,
and outside it on the twenty-second. The same deductible on a level whose window is 45 calendar days remains
inside the window on the forty-fifth day and falls outside it on the forty-sixth.
